rows.ja: 提携・買収・資金調達

companies.name: アリスタネットワークス

relations.text: Sanminaは、Arista Networksの主要な製造パートナーを担う
relations.text_en: Sanmina is one of Arista Networks' primary manufacturing partners.

source.label: Arista Networks 10-K
source.quote: Our primary manufacturing partners are Jabil Inc., Sanmina Corporation and Foxconn Hon Hai.

relations.text: Nokiaが、米国のBuy America基準に適合する最初の製品がSanminaの製造ラインから出荷されたと発表した
relations.text_en: Nokia announced that its first Buy America-compliant products rolled off the Sanmina manufacturing line

source.label: Nokia — Sanmina OLT production, April 24, 2024
source.quote: First Nokia Buy America-Compliant products roll off Sanmina manufacturing line

relations.text: Nokiaは、Sanminaとの当初計画の発表後、光ファイバー・ブロードバンド機器と光モジュールの米国製造を短期間で実現したとしている
relations.text_en: Nokia says it delivered on its commitment to manufacture fiber-optic broadband network electronics and optical modules in the U.S. after announcing initial plans with Sanmina

source.label: Nokia — Sanmina OLT production, April 24, 2024
source.quote: Nokia delivers on commitment to manufacture and produce fiber-optic broadband network electronics and optical modules in the U.S. in record-breaking time after announcing initial plans with Sanmina.
source.note: Nokia側の発表に基づく記載です。

relations.text: Sanminaは2025年5月18日に、AMDの完全子会社AMD Design, LLCからZT Systemsを取得する持分購入契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: On May 18, 2025 Sanmina entered into an Equity Purchase Agreement to acquire ZT Systems from AMD Design, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.

source.label: Sanmina 10-K
source.quote: On May 18, 2025, the Company entered into the Equity Purchase Agreement to acquire ZT Systems from AMD Design, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., pursuant to which the Company will purchase all of the outstanding equity interests of ZT

relations.text: AMDは2025年10月、ZTのデータセンター製造事業をSanminaに現金24億ドルと同社株式120万株で売却した
relations.text_en: AMD sold the ZT data center infrastructure manufacturing business to Sanmina in October 2025 for $2.4 billion in cash and 1.2 million shares of Sanmina common stock

source.label: AMD 10-K
source.quote: with the design operations (ZT Design Business), and in October 2025, we sold the ZT data center infrastructure manufacturing business (ZT Manufacturing Business) to Sanmina Corporation (Sanmina) for $2.4 billion in cash, subject to certain purchase price adjustments, and 1.2 million shares of Sanmina common stock.
source.note: 価格調整の対象となる記載です。

relations.text: Sanminaは2025年10月27日の発表で、AMDと戦略的提携を結んだとしている
relations.text_en: Sanmina's October 27, 2025 release says Sanmina and AMD have committed to a strategic partnership

source.label: Sanmina の発表
source.quote: As part of the agreement, Sanmina and AMD have committed to a strategic partnership

companies.name: バンク・オブ・アメリカ

relations.text: Sanminaは2025年7月29日付で、Bank of America, N.A.などの貸付人とクレジット契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Sanmina has a Credit Agreement dated July 29, 2025 with Bank of America, N.A. and the other lenders party thereto

source.label: Sanmina 10-K
source.quote: 10.23#* Credit Agreement dated as of July 29, 2025 among Sanmina Corporation, certain subsidiaries of Sanmina Corporation designated therein, Bank of America, N.A. and the other lenders party thereto .
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: 同クレジット契約の第1次修正(2025年10月20日付)がある
relations.text_en: Amendment No. 1 to the Credit Agreement is dated October 20, 2025

source.label: 2026年度 Q1 Form 10-Q · Markets / Competition / Risk factors
source.label_en: FY2026 Q1 Form 10-Q · Markets / Competition / Risk factors
source.quote: 10.24#* Amendment No. 1 dated as of October 20, 2025 to Credit Agreement dated as of July 29, 2025 among Sanmina Corporation, certain subsidiaries of Sanmina Corporation designated therein, Bank of America, N.A. and the other lenders party thereto.

relations.text: Sanminaの事業部門42Qが、Amazon Web Services(AWS)のManufacturing and Industrial Competencyを取得した
relations.text_en: Sanmina's 42Q division achieved the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Manufacturing and Industrial Competency

source.label: Sanmina の発表
source.quote: 42Q, a Sanmina division, is a full-featured smart, connected, cloud-based Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solution developed by manufacturers for manufacturers, announced today that it has achieved the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Manufacturing and Industrial Competency.
source.note: 事業部門レベルの記載で、2023年の発表です。

companies.name: リライアンス・インダストリーズ

relations.text: SanminaはRelianceの完全子会社Reliance Strategic Business Ventures Limitedと、インド法人への投資による合弁会社の設立で合意した
relations.text_en: Sanmina agreed with Reliance Strategic Business Ventures Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Reliance Industries Limited, to create a joint venture through an investment in Sanmina's existing Indian entity

source.label: Sanmina の発表
source.quote: Sanmina Corporation (Sanmina) (NASDAQ: SANM), a leading integrated manufacturing solutions company and Reliance Strategic Business Ventures Limited (RSBVL), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Reliance Industries Limited (RIL), India’s largest private sector company, today announced that they have entered into an agreement to create a joint venture through an investment in Sanmina’s existing Indian entity (Sanmina SCI India Private Ltd, “SIPL”).
source.note: 子会社(Reliance Strategic Business Ventures)との合意で、2022年の発表です。
source.note_en: Agreement with a subsidiary (Reliance Strategic Business Ventures); announced in 2022.

companies.name: ベンチマーク・エレクトロニクス

source.label: Sanmina 10-K
source.quote: Our competitors include major global EMS providers, including Benchmark Electronics, Inc., Celestica, Inc., Flex Ltd., Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd.

source.label: Benchmark Electronics 10-K
source.quote: Our competitors include Celestica Inc., Flex Ltd., Jabil Inc., Kimball Electronics Inc., Plexus Corp, and Sanmina Corporation.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
